title: Ines and the Protocol
author: August Delacroix
blurb: Hazel Montrose, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
